## What the platform does

- Practice mode: learn questions and answers without a time constraint; URL can be copied to return to the same question later.
- Exam mode: a fixed number of randomly selected questions under a time limit.
- Question sets: sourced from Ditectrev community repositories.
- Correct answers: reveal and review the right answer for each question.
- AI explanations: Ollama (local), OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, or Ditectrev-powered explanations.
- Progress and trials: secure trial system and optional account for progress.
- Built with: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Appwrite, GraphQL, Azure Cosmos DB, Stripe, and React.

## Exam catalogue

AWS Certified ANS-C01 (Advanced Networking Specialty); AWS Certified CLF-C02 (Cloud Practitioner); AWS Certified DAS-C01 (Data Analytics Specialty); AWS Certified DBS-C01 (Database Specialty); AWS Certified DVA-C02 (Developer Associate); AWS Certified MLS-C01 (Machine Learning Specialty); AWS Certified SAA-C03 (Solutions Architect Associate); AWS Certified SCS-C02 (Security Specialty); AWS Certified SOA-C03 (CloudOps Engineer Associate); GCP ACE (Associate Cloud Engineer); ITIL 4 Foundation (IT Service Management); Microsoft Azure AZ-104, AZ-204, AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-500, AZ-800, AZ-900, SC-900; PRINCE2 Agile Foundation; PSD I; PSM I; PSM II; PSPO I; Salesforce DC (Certified Data Cloud Consultant).

## Subscriptions

Visible monthly plans on https://education.ditectrev.com/pricing (EUR):

1. Ads Free (€1.99) — ad-free experience, all practice questions, progress tracking, mobile responsive.
2. Local Explanations (€2.99) — everything in Ads Free, plus Ollama explanations (local AI, no API costs, offline explanations).
3. BYOK Explanations (€4.99) — everything in Local, plus multiple AI providers (DeepSeek, Google Gemini, Mistral AI, OpenAI) using your API keys.
4. Ditectrev Explanations (€9.99) — everything in BYOK, plus premium AI models on Ditectrev infrastructure, no API key required, unlimited explanations, priority support.

Payments are handled by Stripe.

## Q&A

Q: What is the Practice Tests Exams Platform?
A: It is an open source practice tests exams platform developed by Ditectrev's community. It is a web app for practising certification exams, with practice and exam modes, progress tracking, and AI-powered explanations.

Q: What is Ditectrev?
A: We are IT company providing online education content and IT Consulting.

Q: Where is the company located?
A: We are working fully remotely from different countries and the company is registered in Poland.

Q: What's the difference between BYOK and Ditectrev plans?
A: BYOK requires you to provide your own API keys for AI services, while Ditectrev includes premium AI access using our infrastructure.

Q: Can I change plans anytime?
A: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect at your next billing cycle.

Q: Is Ollama really free with Local plan?
A: Yes! Ollama runs locally on your machine, so there are no API costs. You just need to install Ollama locally.

Q: How do I run Ollama?
A: It requires some technical setup. Ollama works best with Firefox (works out of the box) or Chrome/Edge (permission popup). Not supported in Opera or Safari.

Q: What payment methods do you accept?
A: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, and other payment methods supported by Stripe.
